conviction_note: The event is confirmed pre-open by the issuer's own CNMV filing. H1 is new information (only Q1 is out), but I have no sourced number the market lacks. The one real tension is that Q1 adjusted EBITDA grew +0.6% against a stated 2026 goal of double-digit growth, and the Q3 wholesale spike sits on top of that. It is partly offset by a possible restart of a buyback that has been parked since 3 July. The ~10% free float and small observed results-day moves (-4.1% to +0.3% over five CNMV-timestamped prints) keep the size modest, so the answer is roughly p_up 47 on a 4% move, about -0.25.

already_public.what: Q1 2026 results: adjusted EBITDA EUR33.4m (+0.6% YoY), adjusted net profit EUR16.1m (+11.2%), revenue EUR534.3m (-6.5%), net debt/EBITDA 2.7x

FY2026 guide: double-digit growth in EBITDA and net profit ('En 2026 ... esperamos crecer a doble digito en EBITDA y beneficio neto'), off FY2025 adjusted EBITDA EUR115.6m and adjusted net EUR43.5m; the 2030 plan is EBITDA EUR180m, net EUR85m
Q1 press coverage restating the double-digit ambition and the EUR350m senior bond issued after the quarter
The Elmera (Oslo) bid at NOK41.20 was effectively lost to Fortum's NOK47. Elmera's board went with the alternative (IP 3273, 1 Jul 2026)
EUR75m revolving credit facility signed (ABN AMRO agent) for general corporate purposes and working capital

new_in_release.expect: Q2/H1 2026 numbers are new; only Q1 is out. H1 2025 comparatives: EBITDA EUR59.1m, revenue EUR946.9m, pro-forma net EUR23.2m. Q2 2026 pool prices were low (May EUR54, June EUR69.6/MWh, June 4% below June 2025), so expect revenue down again. EBITDA probably low-to-mid single-digit growth, short of a double-digit run-rate. Direction mildly negative against the guide.

The main unknown: whether 'double-digit EBITDA growth in 2026' is reiterated, softened or dropped, with the Spanish pool at EUR118/MWh in August (+72.8% YoY) and Q4 futures at EUR127. Softening is more likely than raising. I put roughly 35% on a visible softening, the rest on reiteration.

unknown. Working-capital needs rise with wholesale prices, the EUR75m revolver was signed for working capital, and the EUR350m bond refinanced debt. Net debt/EBITDA was 2.7x at Q1 against a 3.0x ceiling.
Possible restart of the share buyback that has been suspended since 3 July (61.31% of the 15m-share programme unexecuted). The Q1 precedent is a restart filed the same afternoon as results.

findings.finding: The 2026 guide is double-digit EBITDA growth (>= ~EUR127m off 115.6m adjusted), but Q1 adjusted EBITDA grew only +0.6% and the Spanish pool has since spiked (Aug EUR118.25/MWh, +72.8% YoY; Q4 futures EUR127). So the H1 release will either show H1 EBITDA well short of a double-digit run-rate or soften the guide. For an independent retailer the macro-to-margin transmission is a hypothesis, not a disclosure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No guide change on record. On results days timestamped by CNMV the stock moved -4.08% (Q1-25, 14 May 2025), -1.19% (H1-25, 30 Sep 2025), -1.97% (Q3-25, 14 Nov 2025), -0.61% (FY25, 26 Feb 2026) and +0.31% (Q1-26, 23 Jun 2026): 4 of 5 negative, all small. The Capital Markets Day that introduced the plan (20 Nov 2025) moved +8.65%, the one time a guide-level item was new.
findings.original_quote: En 2026, inauguramos una nueva hoja de ruta con la que esperamos crecer a doble digito en EBITDA y beneficio neto, manteniendo siempre la disciplina financiera y aversion al riesgo que caracteriza a Audax Renovables (translation: in 2026 we begin a new roadmap under which we expect double-digit growth in EBITDA and net profit, keeping the financial discipline and risk aversion that characterise Audax). Q1: 'EBITDA ... 33,45 millones (+0,6%)'.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The stock is -13% since the Q1 print (1.288 on 23 Jun to 1.124) and -9.65% over 60 days, which is what a market doubting the guide would look like. What is not visible: with two analysts, a frozen EUR2.35 target and no published H1 consensus, nobody has put a number on H1 against the guide. If the market had fully priced a guide cut, the stock would have gapped on a trading update, and none exists (no IP filing since 1 Jul). Sized net: the guide could equally be reiterated on the back of retail margins in a low-price H1, which is why the range spans zero.
findings.independence: Wholesale price series from a different source: https://www.grupoase.net/precio-luz-agosto-2026/ (Aug pool EUR118.25, +72.8% YoY) and BofA flagging Spain as likely to reimpose price caps: https://www.bolsamania.com/noticias/mercados/bofa-preve-ganancias-mayores-esperado-utilities-europeas-precio-gas--23652922.html. Neither is company-level.

findings.finding: The share buyback was suspended on 3 July 'de forma voluntaria y por fines corporativos' with 61.31% of the maximum unexecuted (EUR7.74m spent), and three months on there is still no restart filing. The last suspension ended with a restart filed on the afternoon of the Q1 results day (23/06/2026 16:32), so a restart filed on 29 Sep would reopen roughly EUR12m of buying into a float that trades about EUR0.2m a day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 23 Jun 2026 restart came alongside Q1 results (+0.31% that day). The 20 Nov 2025 buyback launch was paired with the CMD, +8.65%. There is no clean isolated reaction.
findings.original_quote: la Sociedad ha acordado, de forma voluntaria y por fines corporativos, suspender temporalmente la ejecucion del citado Programa de Recompra a partir del dia 3 de julio de 2026 ... quedando pendiente de ejecucion aproximadamente el 61,31% (translation: the Company has voluntarily and for corporate purposes decided to temporarily suspend the buyback programme from 3 July 2026 ... about 61.31% of the maximum remains to be executed)
findings.why_not_priced: The suspension is public, but a restart is not, and nobody aggregates the CNMV autocartera channel for a 2-analyst name. If the market expected an imminent restart, the stock would not have drifted -7.3% over 20 sessions on thin volume with the only disclosed buyer absent. Discounted to about 1/3 probability of a same-day restart, because the 'fines corporativos' reason is unexplained and could still be live after Elmera.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative, which agrees with the negative 20- and 60-day run-ups (-7.26%, -9.65%) rather than cutting against them. So the guidance finding partly restates what the drift already holds, and the buyback finding is the only piece that runs against the lean. Net is near zero.
language_note: The CNMV OIR filing 42760 (Spanish) is the only source for the release timing, 'antes de la apertura de mercado' on 29 Sep with a 12:00 presentation. The English vendor calendar left the session unresolved.
The CNMV autocartera filings (Spanish) carry the buyback suspension 'por fines corporativos' with 61.31% unexecuted, and the same-day restart precedent on 23 Jun. No English source mentions either.
The FY2025 Spanish press note carries the explicit 2026 double-digit EBITDA/net growth guide quote. English coverage summarised only the 2030 targets.
The Spanish energy press (Grupo ASE, Europa Press syndication) carried the August pool EUR118.25/MWh and Q4 futures EUR127. The English BofA note came via Bolsamania in Spanish too.

The Elmera bid history, including Fortum's NOK47 and the ~EUR100m cost escalation, was in both languages (TradingView/Reuters English, Cronica Global Spanish); the Spanish added nothing decisive there.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' and 'too small about the move': H1 numbers are new (not pre-released) and a guide softening is plausible, so abs_move_pct went from 3.0 to 4.0. It stays well below the 7-9% European base because the ~10% free float and five CNMV-timestamped results reactions (0.3-4.1%) are this name's own distribution, and the only >8% day was a plan/buyback launch.
The reaction history (4 of 5 results days negative) was used on p_up, which stays at 47, and not to cap size. The guidance finding moved from -0.5 to -0.55 so the sum matches (2*0.47-1)*4 = -0.24.
'Register not readable' wording in positioning_check, per the covered:false rule; no change to numbers.
'In a live bid, results are noise' was checked and does not apply: Audax was the bidder (Elmera), the bid is lost, and ADX itself is not in an offer period.
